fieldData.korte-beschrijving: Strategy, brand and tooling working as one system produced real momentum: BattMobility grew from 2,000 to 3,000 users, a 50% increase, with a brand and a toolset built to keep scaling. Freedom in Motion, delivered.
fieldData.name: BattMobility - 7

fieldData.korte-beschrijving: Great brands need great tools. We engineered a suite of custom applications, with a Marketing OS at its core, including a socials template builder, an email builder and more. The team now produces branded social posts and emails in minutes, fully on-system, turning the design system into living software.
fieldData.name: BattMobility - 6

fieldData.korte-beschrijving: Photography at scale is slow and expensive. We developed a bespoke AI imagery pipeline to generate on-brand visuals: people, places and vehicles in the BattMobility world. It gives the brand an endless, consistent and ownable image library for campaigns, social and product.
fieldData.name: BattMobility - 5

fieldData.korte-beschrijving: To keep everything consistent as the brand scaled, we built a complete design system: the BattMobility 2025 Style Guide. Colour, type, spacing, components, iconography and rules for every touchpoint, captured as reusable tokens and templates so the team can create on-brand material at speed, without us in the room.
fieldData.name: BattMobility - 4

fieldData.korte-beschrijving: The identity had to feel human, optimistic and effortlessly modern: mobility that belongs to everyone. We designed a flexible visual language built around motion and energy, with a fresh colour palette and confident typography that works from a phone screen to the side of a vehicle.
fieldData.name: BattMobility - 2

fieldData.korte-beschrijving: Every strong brand begins with clarity. Through research and stakeholder sessions we defined BattMobility’s purpose, positioning and proposition, then translated it into a concrete go-to-market strategy: who to reach first, what to promise, and how to grow. A roadmap that took the brand from concept to a living, growing community.
fieldData.name: BattMobility - 1

fieldData.korte-beschrijving: How do you turn a bold idea, shared electric mobility for everyone, into a brand people trust and a business that scales? BattMobility set out to give communities freedom of movement without the burden of car ownership. Our job: shape the strategy, build the brand, and engineer the digital tools that bring Freedom in Motion to life.
fieldData.name: BattMobility - 0

fieldData.korte-beschrijving: To ensure consistent communication across all touch points, we conducted a thorough brand check, refreshing each point of interaction. This included new merchandise, business cards, mailing templates, social media templates and much more. And, of course, the icing on the cake was the agency's new website. We also had the honour of designing the stand for Fanfinity's unveiling of their new name at FTI (Flanders Technology & Innovation), allowing them to showcase their brand to the public.
fieldData.name: Fanfinity - 5

fieldData.korte-beschrijving: The entire brand identity is built using a grid system inspired by the aesthetics of popular trading card games. Simplified into four (and more) versatile shapes, the design system offers flexibility in every application. The fresh and youthful brand colours resonate with fans and publishers/brands alike. TT Commons was selected as the font, radiating a friendly appearance perfectly aligned with the Fanfinity team.
fieldData.name: Fanfinity - 3

fieldData.korte-beschrijving: Fanfinity is dedicated to lowering barriers and making gaming accessible and inclusive for all. Their diverse team has extensive experience in gaming, events and community building. Fanfinity connects people and brands online and offline to create long-term professional relationships. Together, they bring their enthusiasm and creativity to projects to create meaningful fan experiences and share happiness to strengthen gaming culture.
fieldData.name: Fanfinity - 1

fieldData.korte-beschrijving: How to merge 2 companies under 1 name and ensure that their mission (creating better fan experiences) shines through the new brand. Tournamentcenter & We Are Esports joined forces under a fresh name: Fanfinity. An agency on a mission: creating meaningful fan experiences for game publishers and brands looking to establish lasting bonds with gaming communities, empowering gaming culture.
fieldData.name: Fanfinity - 0

fieldData.korte-beschrijving:
The full brand story is seamlessly integrated into all our deliverables. We delivered clear social media templates, but the website is the ultimate focal point for the brand.

Our user-friendly website design highlights all of The Smiles' activities and packages. With a clear user interface, we make it easy for visitors to explore the wide range of activities.
fieldData.name: Smiles - Website

fieldData.korte-beschrijving: We took on the challenge of visually capturing the brand identity through bright imagery, taking inspiration from The Smiles' interior. Authentic people add a human touch that embodies the essence of The Smiles. Each activity was carefully recorded, filling the website with original images that make the brand authentic.
fieldData.name: Smiles - Imagery

fieldData.korte-beschrijving:
The brand evokes warmth, joy and happiness, which is reflected in its extensive colour palette of inviting, vibrant hues. This approachable and human feel is consistent across all touchpoints. Using the power of motion, we bring the brand to life. The bowling LED wall displays dynamic animations that blend seamlessly into the interior.

Consistency is key in every aspect of our brand story, the menu card is attractive and invites you to enjoy one of the restaurant's delicious meals. Authentic imagery, capturing real smiles from real visitors, enhances the welcoming atmosphere.

‍
fieldData.name: Smiles - Art Direction

fieldData.korte-beschrijving:
The goal was to design a logo that conveys both fun and elegance. We took inspiration from the Entertainment Gallery's interior lighting and designed a logo that puts a smile on your face at first glance. Reflecting the youthful, positive and joyful spirit of the venue, with a touch of sophistication, our logo perfectly captures the spirit of The Smiles.

With a vibrant colour palette, bold typography and playful graphics, the brand stands out from it's competitors and invites customers to experience the excitement inside.
fieldData.name: Smiles - Brand Identity

fieldData.korte-beschrijving:
The Smiles offers innovative entertainment in a family-friendly environment. With 10,000 m2 of varied activities, state-of-the art bowling, Tag Active, challenging karting (coming soon), arcade games, karaoke, indoor & outdoor playground, pool & darts, all in a unique interior, it is the Entertainment Gallery of Knokke-Heist.

Enjoy a day full of fun with your family and friends, cosy & delicious food and smiles from our dedicated Smile Providers.
fieldData.name: Smiles - About The Brand

fieldData.korte-beschrijving:
At the request of former mayor Leopold Lippens, Valerie Vanhonsebrouck took on the challenge of building a new entertainment complex in Knokke. With over 10,000m2 of space for bowling, karting, dining and more, Valerie enlisted our help in branding the venue.

Welcome to The Smiles - Entertainment Gallery, Knokke's premier indoor hotspot for fun and excitement. Come to a world of entertainment, where laughter and adventure await around every corner.
fieldData.name: Smiles - Challenge

fieldData.korte-beschrijving: We issued a press release that was sent to all West Flemish media channels. This was picked up by several press agencies. This way, we created an enormous boost in brand awareness for The Payroll Office.
fieldData.name: TPO - PR & Communications

fieldData.korte-beschrijving: Convenient templates ensure consistent communication of The Payroll Office across all social media channels. An animated launch video provides the push the brand needs to grow on social media.
fieldData.name: TPO - Social Media

fieldData.korte-beschrijving: For The Payroll Office, we developed a clear one-pager that highlights the full brand experience. The personal character also emerges here. It was made very easy for potential customers to schedule a meeting with the founders.
fieldData.name: TPO - Website

fieldData.korte-beschrijving: The brand templates feature a playful graphic element. The Pantone print provides a vibrant colour that highlights the dynamic character of the brand.
fieldData.name: TPO - Brand Templates

fieldData.korte-beschrijving: The baseline - personal payroll management and advice for the entrepreneurial employer - was chosen as secondary communication. The tone of voice of The Payroll Office is young and transparent but always professional and informal.
fieldData.name: TPO - Tone Of Voice

fieldData.korte-beschrijving: We put the founders of The Payroll Office centre stage with a very personal visual language. This fits perfectly with the graphic brand identity. We chose images with a high level of light and human interaction. This way, we stay true to the mission of the brand.
fieldData.name: TPO - Imagery

fieldData.korte-beschrijving: The logo of The Payroll Office was formed out of a pay slip. The personal aspect is reflected in the fingerprint present in the logo. The wave motion of the letter P translates “the pay” and“the roll”. We opted for a remarkable colour palette and a font that highlights the young and dynamic character of this company.
fieldData.name: TPO - Art Direction

fieldData.korte-beschrijving: You are not a number at The Payroll Office. We position the company as a very personal and transparent brand. You can expect payroll management with no surprises and a fixed package price per employee. In addition, The Payroll Office offers accessible consultancy thanks to their years of expertise. This makes it possible for smalland mid-size enterprises to receive grounded and tailor-made advice.
fieldData.name: TPO - Positioning

fieldData.korte-beschrijving: The Payroll Office is more than a commercial identity. They are dedicated to their purpose. It is their mission to help smalland mid-size enterprises in a professional way with payroll management that is provided by people with a love of the trade.
fieldData.name: TPO - Purpose

fieldData.korte-beschrijving: We defined the brand as a personal payroll partner for the entrepreneurial employer. The Payroll Office offers customised, to-the-point consultancy in the language of the entrepreneur. This allows them to focus on running their business instead of personnel administration.
fieldData.name: TPO - Brand Definition

fieldData.korte-beschrijving: From our name sprint, "The Payroll Office" proved to be the most ideal name for this brand. It truly describes the core activities of the company and thus pulls transparency throughout the brand.
fieldData.name: TPO - Naming

fieldData.korte-beschrijving: To ensure that The Payroll Office stands out in the crowd of payrolling offices, we opt for a very transparent pricing. So transparently that they are listed on the website. This has never been done before.The Payroll Office decisively chooses accessible consultancy that helps entrepreneurs flourish.
fieldData.name: TPO - Brand Opportunities

fieldData.korte-beschrijving: A brief market survey quickly made it clear that the need for unrecognised payrolling offices is very high in Flanders. Small and mid-size enterprises are especially looking for a payroll partner that offers them tailor-made personal advice.
fieldData.name: TPO - Concept Validation

fieldData.korte-beschrijving: Together with The Payroll Office, we have discovered many valuable insights that form the foundation of an innovative strategy in the payrolling sector. A personal approach & accessible consultancy are the key principles of the brand.
fieldData.name: TPO - Brand Ideation

fieldData.korte-beschrijving: Kenny & Mathias came to us to setup a new payrolling office. They were looking for a more personal approach than the existing offices. A clear strategic framework was essential.
fieldData.name: TPO - Challenge

fieldData.korte-beschrijving: We developed a template for the Miles Ahead sessions, a series of free in real life networking nights with different speakers that are experts in the field of Deep Tech & AI.
fieldData.name: Miles Ahead 16

fieldData.korte-beschrijving: Social media templates were delivered to ensure that everyone from the venture studio could communicate within the brand identity in a simple manner. This way, the thought leadership of MilesAhead is emphasised.
fieldData.name: Miles Ahead 14

fieldData.korte-beschrijving: We developed a website that is clearly aimed at the founders. A convenient CMS ensures that the operating partners can easily provide updates on the ins and outs of the venture studio.
fieldData.name: Miles Ahead 13

fieldData.korte-beschrijving: We choose a visual language that fits the brand and clearly appeals to our target audience, with an emphasis on technology and data. By using an icon and a defined colour palette, we can design an unlimited set of 3D images that always fit the brand identity.
fieldData.name: Miles Ahead 12

fieldData.korte-beschrijving: To reflect the venture studio's personal approach, we portray Miles Ahead's professionals in their environment.
fieldData.name: Miles Ahead 11

fieldData.korte-beschrijving: We used the sound waves of the originalMiles Ahead song as the base for the new logo. In this manner, we clearly refer to the role that is taken as a producer. The colour palette was chosen based on the first Miles Ahead album, these vibrant colours are the foundation of a distinctive brand. The colours in combination with the selected font give the brand a technical character.
fieldData.name: Miles Ahead 9

fieldData.korte-beschrijving: It is the mission of Miles Ahead to shorten the learning curve of early stage Deep Tech & AI startups by producing their business together with the Miles Ahead experts. Through this short and intensive creative process, Miles Ahead accelerates the go-to-market.This way, they help increase the return for the founder.
fieldData.name: Miles Ahead 8

fieldData.korte-beschrijving: The brand is defined as a venture studio that helps first-time Deep Tech & AI founders grow by producing and funding their business in a stimulating environment. The personal aspect is very important here, hence the deliberate choice of using people in the brand.
fieldData.name: Miles Ahead 6

fieldData.korte-beschrijving: Together with the team of Miles Ahead, we rephrased their elevator pitch and brand communication to convince first-time founders to work with Miles Ahead. From the ideation, it quickly became clear that the brand's key principles are People, Purpose & Potential.
fieldData.name: Miles Ahead 5

fieldData.korte-beschrijving: Miles Ahead considers itself the producer in this story where they launch Deep Tech & AI startups. We use this approach along with Miles Davis' album as reference points for the brand.
fieldData.name: Miles Ahead 4

fieldData.korte-beschrijving: The brand analysis showed that the venture studio model is not yet widely known in Belgium. Therefore, it is very important that the proposal of Miles Ahead is communicated in abite-size manner.
fieldData.name: Miles Ahead 3

metadata.description: For the 2017 season, Glossy.tv was asked to develop the complete team identity for the new Quick-Step Pro Cycling Team. As passionate cycle lovers, it was our pleasure to create a fresh and up-to-date identity for one of the most iconic teams in the peloton. The jerseys, the stationary, the deliverables ...
